verdict.rationale: There is a direct first-party claim that Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback and links them to related feature ideas, matching the story almost verbatim. However, this is a single marketing-page claim with no technical documentation, hands-on demonstration, or independent corroboration of how the AI detection works or its accuracy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI insight-detection feature, documentation of the underlying model/methodology, and evidence of reliability at scale.
